name: Mashimo Ran
source: The mysterious young transfer student to Jigen Academy, Ran follows his desire for revenge against the man who murdered his father and older brother. Ran is a talented psychic who is gifted in telepathy, fire manipulation, and psychometry. He forms a strange friendship with Mariko and tries to help with her psychological problems.
